sourceMaterial.sourceEvidence: PO Ownership: Owning Value Delivery; Leading the Value Chain. PO Trust: Executing Stakeholder Decisions; Building Stakeholder Confidence. PO System: Collaborating Across the Value Chain; Leading Product Ecosystems.
sourceMaterial.relationshipLogic: PO behaviours may indicate responsibility for product value or value-chain leadership alongside behaviours that suggest reliance on stakeholder decisions or a need to build stakeholder confidence. This may point to a tension between product accountability and perceived authority.
